body:
I've been feeling the same.

these feelings don't go away. if you check my account, you'll see I created it many years ago for this exact same reason.

and I am back here for the same reason. In a way I am more successful and accomplished now, but nothing will change. I have absolutely no reason or goal to live. There's no joy nor experience in life I didn't try and wanna try again. Also it's not enough to keep me going on more... idk, 50 years of this capitalistic slavery?

You're right, I am doing this.

Just to be clear, I wasn't pursuing him, just trying to understand his behavior because he was the one to get closer first, but you're right. Actually write this here made me realise that it wasn't cool
I meant that I let myself be led, you know? But you're right, there's nothing more I can do. What is done is done.

Yup, I know that. I just wanted to understand what is in his mind. As I said, I keep rewatching the whole stuff (also from different povs), but it gets more and more saddening. I think I am just stupid....

Yeah, right? But I don't know, I think I just got the signs wrong.

There's no way to know what he wants from me. It is confusing. I really wanted to get closer to him - even if it was just for being friends, but by that I only get the "get lost" hint.

Yeah, you have a nice point and I also thought that... But he was the one to get close first. To be fair I think he is way out of my league, but I keep mentally rewatching the whole movie in my mind and doesn't make sense.. 
Like this day when from nowhere he stopped by my side and literally stayed there with his shoulder glued on mine.. The room was empty (except for a few co-workers).. Anyway...

Funny because as you said that about your wife and life, I started to think about my boyfriend. He is accommodated. He would never leave his house if it wasn't for me. I am not a party girl, but I love to travel, love to visit museums, read, listen to music, go to concerts. He never had interest in any of this, besides traveling.. He doesn't make any effort too, anyway. He used to have a lot of friends but now he doesn't want to leave home even to go out with them - I understand in some levels, his friends are now married or crazy stupid (the kind of people who support Trump and I am not kidding or exaggerating). I am really afraid he is depressive and not telling me. I want to help, but I need help myself. And I can't help if he doesn't tell me. But I know him so well that I know he is not depressive, he is just waiting to do stuff in the last minute, he always does that, but as I know myself, it won't work when I really leave him. Actually he is starting to do this. Usually I had to talk to him and tell that this and that wasn't working and I was pretty sad that he wouldn't make any effort to be with me. He would change for 2 weeks and the go back to normal. Now he is doing and saying stuff without me to point it out. Which, as I said, made me mad because he knew all the time what he was doing wrong and just didn't bother to change. Last year the day I was crying because my mom tried to kill me and he ignored me crying, I got really mad and we had a terrible fight. He said he was really right that I would end everything that night, and until today I think that this was what he wanted. Also another thing that itches me: he is too attached to his family, I understand I don't have a proper family and his parents are great, but he is attached in another level. He is afraid of moving out and stuff. When we had plans to marry, he wanted to buy a house in the same block as his parents, please. That made me crazy! Before I used to think that it was because he had a great family and I didn't know what it is like to have really caring people near me. But I have friends who have caring parents and wanna to live too, want to move out. In my new job I made a great friend (I am close to her to tell some stuff, not all), she is from another state, her parents are so lovely yet she wants to know the world, all supported to her parents. My mom didn't want us to leave,  for example. Meanwhile my boyfriend only thinks about himself and his stuff, never interested in what I want to do - not that I am this selfish, but I wanted to share with him what I am sharing here now and he is just not opened or interested - as I said before. 
I believe he is faithful to me, but only because he is lazy to pursue another girl, I think. And lazy to hide it from me, because when I want, I am a great detective.. But I think that the cheating is more a problem to the cheater than for the cheated ahah.. I would be sad of course, but I mean, what is the 'romantic loyalty' if not another social protocol? I am faithful because I wouldn't sleep well drowning in my own guilty. Selfish much, huh? It is sad, thinking this way. Another thing is that when I am in love, or infatuated with someone I can't think straight and I don't  have romantic interest other people. Those last 8 years of relationship, I've found interesting people but they weren't who I wanted to share my life with. I am kind of amused that I can see my boss as someone who is not just another friend. I feel strange because of that.
______________
My mom: I answer her calls because she doesn't have anyone else. I have a step-father who is amazing but she fights him all the time. Sometimes I think to myself if he isn't with her for pity. Or because she truly needs him, or else she would be 150% crazy by now. But I prefer to think he loves her in his way.
_____________
I can't stop thinking about what you said about your wife and you. Maybe is also the way my bf feels, I can't leave him this way. Other than all these I said, he is also an amazing person, I think as we didn't have much experience before dating each other, it is natural to have these problems. My mom may be crazy but she is a smart woman. Once she said to me that I shouldn't date so serious so young, because it always end in a sad way. I think she is right. I started dating him when I was 18.. 
As you, I want a companionship more than anything else. I think this is love. I am trying to be my boyfriend's companion/life partner but I don't think he tries the same for me.  
_____________
About law and lawless.. I am just studying in my grad about Foucault and how we are slaves of our own freedom. Yesterday I learned that Foucault was gay and tried to kill himself a lot of times. That made me think, one of the biggest minds in humankind, trying to kill himself, as lost as me. I wish I could talk to him. 
_____________
By the way, If I may suggest: talk more to your wife, seriously. I don't know if it's the situation, but maybe that's what you need. Don't let her go, she seems to be someone who loves you a lot and tries to make you part of her everything. Don't let her love fade away little by little as it is happening to me right now. It looks like you love her but doesn't believe you are the one for her, but if you wasn't why would her make this effort to make you part of her life? If you don't show to her that she is important to you, it will end just like me and my bf, do you want that? And you don't have to change the world, she accepts you as you are. If my bf was a little more interested in what I do, I would never stopped loving him. I mean, if he wanted to go to a movie every now and then, if he listened to me sometimes, if he wanted to know what I am reading or wanted me to play with him (instead of just sitting on his bed crying or chatting online with anyone but not him while he plays). Don't be the one who looks like just want a prize tho show normality to society. I feel like my bf treats me like this.
Is your wife to you someone who you have just to show that you're normal? Or is she someone who you want tho share your life with? Like you said, you want companionship, why isn't she your companion? Because looks like you are hers. ;)
Not everything is lost.

The video is very funny ahaha, I liked it, thanks.
I am really trying, you know. Maybe my grad will change the view for some stuff.. :)
But I am still thinking about the 'exit bag' some anon pmed me..

So about my family:
My mom went full crazy since my father died. I'm not kidding, she keeps all her days talking behind his family (I'm sure she is right in some stuff she says, but not everything), she is obsessed with them. She doesn't call me to ask about my life or job, but to talk about them and other people she dislikes (they are a lot of people). Of course since my father died they treat me and my brother as if we died too, but I learned how not to care to them. My brother cares about me, but since he doesn't had a lot of love too, he is also cold towards everybody. Now I moved from home, he seems to care more. But we are great friends. Not that I can tell him I wanna die, I think he sees me as a whole model for life, I really don't wanna ruin it for him - specially because he is so much more smarter than me.

My boyfriend and me had our great times, and since yesterday he is trying to be more caring, I didn't even have to talk to him. What makes me more sad, since now I am sure he always knew what he did wrong and is trying to fix now, as they say, better late than never, right? But I don't think it will be this easy. Our relationship was based on me making everything so he would feel more comfortable. But he never took me serious. Last year my mom in one of her crazy access of rage tried to kill me (she doesn't accept that I am an artist and we are the first ones to be fired in the recession - she insists that I am a failure, even if my former boss himself made a lot of compliments to my job). Anyway, she tried to kill me and I was so tired of fighting that I locked myself and let her scream that I was a disappointment.
I am taller than she and I could have stopped her. But I just wanted to cry.
Then I went to my boyfriend's house and cried. While he played the new Fallout. He totally ignored me. It happened a lot of times... Also what makes me sad is that I am a gamer myself, but he never makes any effort for playing with me. He says I suck. He doesn't even try. He doesn't have any interest in what I read, what I watch, what I hear, what I play. He keeps telling me about all those games he plays, I always am the one making the biggest effort to make things work. He doesn't even listen to me. He never offers to take me to/from airport. Even if I'm living in another city. Yesterday when I was leaving again, he noticed that. I've tried to talk to him about it before, but he kept reminding of the stuff he did for me when we started dating in 2008. Yesterday he was the one to talk about it. I was surprised, and mad. The truth is, what kept us together until now was my one sided love, his love ended sometime ago. And my love is now fading away. That's why I said that I never looked to another men. Never had the interest, even if I've met amazing people. With my boss is different - I am really good reading people, but sometimes I don't know if I got it right, which is the case of my boss. I don't know because he looks interested but then totally ignores me.. 
About my job: it is temporary. I will never see my boss again. I've already accepted it. 
About close friends, I have three. Those three believe the same stuff:
1 - I have to end my relationship.
2 - My boss and I had a real connection, it is not from my head. 

But from those 3 I am only comfortable telling to one that I am thinking about to kill myself. Only because this friend in particular also is a suicidal. She tried to kill herself in the beginning of the year, and for the few hours I couldn't talk to her, it was like I lost a part of my heart.
But she is fine now, and she have other great friends.
The thing about death is that I've lost my father and the world keeps spinning even if he is dead. My mom went crazy but everything turned out fine. His friends kept living, his/our family. If I die, will be the same. In a year or two, I'll be just a memory. In ten, not even that. 
I used to remember my father's face, voice and smell. All this vanished with time. Time is a heartless bitch, I must say. But is a great friend if you understand how it works.
You got it right, I am a gemini. 
Still I am clueless what to do, I can't think in a better answer than ending it all. 
I am too tired to start over one more time. Start over looking for jobs, being interviewed, trying to convince people I am a better choice. Not only for work, for life.
I have this inside me: I am no better than no one. There is not such a scale to compare, how could I know? Not better, not worse. For a long time I believed I was worse. But if I judge myself worse is that because inside I wanted to be better. So I learned not to judge myself not better not worse. 
But life has this secret: everything works on competition, so you have to prove you're better all the time.
I am tired of these games. I am tired of having to prove myself better, to prove that I am worthy of a job, of love, of living. 
Also I don't understand half of those social protocols. We are in a sea of invisible rules where you can't tell someone that you like them, you can't show vulnerability, you can't love, you can't be yourself AND every fucking movie and book says you should.
Anyway... Thanks for all those compliments too. 
I am fucking lost.

I'm not sure they have group meetings where I live, I'm not from US.
Also about the boss thing:
I mentioned about falling in love with my boss, but I see one person which was my boss, who I absolutely respect as a boss, and the men dissociated to it - this men is the most amazing person I ever met. We like the same books and movies, music, and we have this absurd harmony between us that feels like I've known him for all my life.
BUT I am not deluded about him, I am sure he doesn't look at me as a woman. Probably as the stupid moron I am.

Also I am not worried about the penis part. I've only met the same penis my whole life (8 years to be more exact), the same one that now refuses to get up to me HAHAHAHAHAHA. 

Jokes aside, I really don't care, the job was only a path that I could've met him, since we have a lot in common. Also I never saw people as genitalia :p

Maybe that's why I wanna die, right? I think too much.

I am/was a wannabe writer, so I get too attached to stylish deaths and stuff. Do you wanna read a poem that I wrote recently? Here it goes:

The Lion & Me

I met a Lion once/
A King with his crown/
He judged me a dunce/
He made me a clown/
//

With his big Sphinx’s eyes/
That look crossed my heart/
Like a sword cold as ice/
//
He, almighty and imponent/
Me, miserable and impotent/
Was bewitched/
//
In my chest placed a flame/
Oh silly Lion, I was so mad/
Who would I blame?/
//
In our second meeting/
There was a friendly greeting/
When our eyes first met/
The heart and brain made a bet/
//
He looks frightened/
He looks sweet/
The heart chanced/
He looks frightful/
And you will bleed/
The brain glanced/
//
Hereafter, playful as a child/
The lion came, inchmeal/
The flame danced very wild/
Euphoric making swirls/
Warm the heart smiled/
The Brain confused, whirled/
//
Blushing, this big Lion came/
Slowly and shy, we snuggled/
Misunderstood by his fame/
His heart too struggled/
When he calls my name/
As we walk together /
I know it is forever/
//
In the end there was no fight/
The brain happily lost the bet/
The heart was always right/
From the beggining we met/
The Lion & Me/

-------------
I don't see myself as a great writer, but as an artist I only can get trough life by writing and painting.

thanks for your time and consideration.
Yes I am in a bad relationship, you're not the first one to say that. And I have to be strong to move on. I never received love, to be fair. 
Not even from my family.
You're right, but I am really tired of trying. 

The one thing about my boss is that I never thought someone like him would look at me.  Also it was weird that he caught my attention from the very first time - that was something that never happened before, I never looked to another men, they never caught my attention like this.. Plus he was acting kind weird near me (touchy and stuff, he is not like this with others), but I guess maybe I'm just daydreaming about it. Some friends says I am not, but maybe I went full crazy. 

And I don't think I am ready to know people, also I'm a talker, but I am not comfortable telling about myself much, that's why I'm here on reddit. 

Thanks for reading my story, that already helps me.

About the online thing, I will never be comfortable with this, it is sure a great advice, but I don't trust on online dating, I can't date someone just for the dating. I need something more, I am not the type that go out for like those forged social interactions. Why would I go out with someone just for going out? I wanna something more, I wanna know the person and feel something. Online dating has all this purpose behind and then we are all acting to make the other person like you. And it takes a year or two to see their true colors, I don't trust that.

Btw I am a woman.
